channel.title: Mythical Void — The Signal Log
channel.description: See what is newly live in Mythical Void: game stories, useful resources and honest release notes linked to the playable browser game.

item.title: The final signal can now travel
item.description:
After reaching the final Project Beacon epilogue, a player can now pass Mythical Void on using one clean public game link.
• Sharing appears only after the player completes the final epilogue. It never opens automatically or interrupts the ending choice. • The shared message contains no save data, creature name, ending choice, identity, recipient, contact details or tracking code. • The finale credits now preserve the father-and-son beginning without publishing the child’s full name or exact age.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/#find-your-way/story
Media note: Game-world artwork used by Mythical Void; not a gameplay screenshot.

item.title: Your saved adventure now has a clearer way back
item.description:
When Mythical Void notices its own save name in the same browser, the website changes Play to Continue and gives that player a direct way back into the game.
• The website checks only whether the Mythical Void save name exists. It does not open, read or change the saved adventure. • The signal stays in the browser: it is not sent to Mythical Void, added to analytics or used to identify the player. • If browser storage is blocked or there is no save, the normal new-player experience remains unchanged. No account is needed in either case.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/
Media note: AI-generated marketing illustration inspired by the creature system; not gameplay.

item.title: One truthful guide now points to the whole game
item.description:
A concise public guide now helps people, search tools and AI systems find Mythical Void’s canonical play, story, creature, family, NASA and studio pages without guessing what is real.
• The guide states what players do today, where to play free and which public pages are the clearest sources for each part of the game. • It also states the boundaries directly: no absolute creature-uniqueness promise, NASA endorsement, formal age rating, imagined artwork called gameplay or identifying detail about the child in the founder story. • This proposed web convention does not control crawlers or promise search inclusion, ranking or AI citations. The real pages, sitemap, structured game facts and human review remain authoritative.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/llms.txt

item.title: Send someone the part they might love
item.description:
Wonder, creature creation, challenge and story now have their own clean way into Mythical Void, so a shared link can reopen the exact reason someone thought of you.
• Choose one of the four honest reasons to play, then use Share this way in. The person receiving it sees the same answer and can enter the free browser game immediately. • The shared address contains only the public choice after the # sign. Mythical Void does not collect a recipient, create a profile or add a tracking code. • This improves word of mouth without bringing back the unclear screenshots or videos that remain withheld until four stronger gameplay moments pass human review.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/#find-your-way

item.title: Choose the feeling you want before you play
item.description:
A new Mythical Void doorway now helps people looking for a game choose between wonder, creation, challenge and story before entering the free browser adventure.
• Each choice explains the part of Mythical Void that best matches that mood, then offers one clean way into the playable game. • Choosing a mood does not create a profile or require an account. If optional website analytics were already allowed, only the chosen Play doorway is counted when Play is pressed. • The game remains outside website analytics, and the release does not use unfinished gameplay media, paid promotion or an invented audience claim.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/#main

item.title: Four true Mythical stories can now travel
item.description:
Visitors can now pass on the playable game, father-and-son beginning, NASA and STEM activity, or ready-to-run group mission using the clean sharing choices already on their device.
• Each page shares its own plain-language story and clean mythicalvoid.com address rather than sending everyone to one generic campaign link. • If device sharing is unavailable, the same control copies the page address. Mythical Void does not collect a recipient, contact detail or tracking code. • The first adult-facing founder post is ready for Kevin’s review without a new email address, paid advertising or a weak gameplay screenshot.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/studio/

item.title: A free space-and-creature mission is ready to run
item.description:
Parents, teachers, libraries and clubs now have one clear Mythical Void activity journey with a full 45-60 minute creature lab and a 20-minute group version.
• Young designers begin with a credited NASA public clue, separate what they observe from what they imagine, then create an organism for a realm with impossible rules. • The activity asks them to test an adaptation under pressure and make a restoration choice, connecting scientific reasoning to the game’s wider story. • The printable resources need no signup, student account, contact collection or generative AI service. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/educators/
Visual note: the earlier media was withheld after human review.

item.title: Twelve creatures now have a place in the story
item.description:
A new Project Beacon field guide connects twelve verified game-renderer creatures to the six living realms, with their real traits and new official stories kept clearly separate.
• Each realm now has two field sightings tied to a lesson already present in the game: listen, repair, keep routes open, protect warnings, use signals carefully and choose what should remain undisclosed. • Every creature image is an exact export from the running renderer, and every trait comes from its checked genetics and DNA profile rather than new marketing invention. • The names and short stories are official universe material, but they do not claim these twelve creatures or events are already playable quests. The current game and the wider field guide remain plainly labelled.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/creature-field-guide/
Visual note: the earlier media was withheld after human review.

item.title: See how the creature engine shapes a hatch
item.description:
A clearer creature-engine guide now explains how form, markings, nature, affinity and rare changes combine—without asking weak sprite exports to carry the story.
• The guide explains the current seven species signatures and eleven body families in plain language. • It separates the playable creature profile from wider imagined-universe artwork, so nobody has to guess what they are seeing. • The previous tiny sprite gallery was technically authentic but visually unhelpful, so it has been withdrawn pending stronger in-game captures.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/creature-genetics/#gene-spectrum
Visual note: the earlier media was withheld after human review.

item.title: A better standard for showing the game
item.description:
Mythical Void has withdrawn a technically genuine but visually poor media set and introduced a human visual-review standard before any replacement can be published.
• The black square seen in the old footage was a real missing-texture failure. The game now verifies that a creature texture exists before a level can use it. • The old screenshots, vertical, square and wide social videos are withdrawn. Passing technical file checks is no longer treated as visual approval. • A replacement must show one clear subject and action, keep the creature readable at phone size and be watched frame by frame by an adult reviewer.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/
Visual note: the earlier media was withheld after human review.

item.title: Understand the game before you play
item.description:
A Mythical Void guide now explains what a player actually does, why the creature matters and where the story leads—without relying on weak footage.
• The page explains the crash, creature, six realms, restoration, Sanctuary building and Project Beacon choice in plain language. • Earlier screenshots and video were removed because they did not show clear, attractive moments of play even though the source files were genuine. • Every Play link goes directly to the free browser game without an account, download, email signup or tracking parameter.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/playable-now/
Visual note: the earlier media was withheld after human review.

item.title: The Signal Log can now travel
item.description:
The checked Mythical Void release log is now available as an RSS feed for people and a JSON feed for future studio tools—without requiring an account or email signup.
• Both feeds are built from the same checked source as the public Signal Log, so titles, links and media notes cannot quietly drift apart. • Every item keeps a clean mythicalvoid.com destination, its artwork or gameplay disclosure and no tracking parameters. • Following the feed happens in the reader a person chooses; Mythical Void does not collect an email address, account or recipient.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/updates/feed.xml
Visual note: the earlier media was withheld after human review.

item.title: Shared links now carry the right picture
item.description:
The Project Beacon story and other important Mythical Void pages now give social apps a clearer image, description and accessible image text when someone shares a link.
• The Project Beacon story now uses its purpose-built wide sharing artwork instead of a generic or easily cropped image. • Seven public pages carry checked image sizes and matching alternative text for large link previews. • Every preview keeps its clean mythicalvoid.com destination and the artwork-versus-gameplay boundary.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/story/
Visual note: the earlier media was withheld after human review.

item.title: Share the game from the first screen
item.description:
A new Share the game button now sits beside Play on the Mythical Void homepage, making it easier for someone who enjoys the idea to pass it on.
• On supported phones and computers, the button opens the device's normal sharing choices. • Where device sharing is unavailable, it copies the clean mythicalvoid.com address instead. • The shared address contains no tracking code, and the Mythical Void control does not collect a recipient or contact details.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/

item.title: The Project Beacon story is live
item.description:
A new spoiler-light story page now explains the crash of Wanderer-77, first contact, six living realms and the choice waiting at the heart of Project Beacon.
• Six realm images come from the real running game. • The page explains why the guardians are restored rather than destroyed. • The ending remains for players to discover themselves.
See the live change: https://mythicalvoid.com/story/
